items.html: And since the three upper ones are the letters YHV of the HaVaYaH behind his shoulders of Arich Anpin, and there is no such great illumination there, therefore they do not have enough to illuminate except in the two lower ones, and not in three, as their number. There remained now the last Hey of the upper HaVaYaH, and the lower Hey of the lower HaVaYaH behind his shoulders of Arich Anpin, and these illuminate here in ZA, in the attribute of Vnakke.
